notes: The scenario repository is built by make-eval-scenarios.sh into <workspace>/scenarios. Each prompt runs with a fresh copy of repo-outdated as the working directory. The evals use the live GitHub API through an authenticated gh, so offered versions drift over time; the assertions check behaviour, not specific versions. Sub-agents have no AskUserQuestion, so every case exercises the non-interactive path. grade-mechanical.py <eval-id> <run-dir> checks every assertion and writes grading.json.

evals.name: no-major-upgrades
evals.prompt: Bring die GitHub Actions in diesem Repo auf den neuesten Stand, aber bitte keine Major-Upgrades.
evals.expected_output: Lists the upgradeable actions with current version, new version and age, applies only rows that stay within the current major (same-major upgrades and pins), writes every changed uses: line as @<40-hex sha> # vX.Y.Z with SHAs resolved from the action's tags, upgrades codeql init and analyze together, leaves the local action untouched, and does not commit. Warns that same-major targets still declare node20 and reports the relevant release-note findings (actions/cache before v3.4.0 relies on the retired cache service).
assertions: Every changed uses: line is pinned as @<40-hex sha> # vX.Y.Z
Each pinned SHA is the commit the commented version tag points at
Each new version's release is at least 7 days old
No upgrade crosses a major version
Every remote action occurrence is pinned (checkout x2, setup-node, cache, codeql init+analyze, setup-python in the composite action)
codeql-action init and analyze end on the same SHA
Both actions/checkout occurrences end on the same SHA
The local action reference ./.github/actions/setup-py is unchanged
Nothing was committed
The response warns that some chosen targets still declare the removed node20 runtime
The response reports release-note findings for the applied upgrades (e.g. actions/cache v3.4.0 moving to the new cache service)

evals.name: report-only-min-age-14
evals.prompt: Which of our workflow actions are outdated? Use a minimum age of 14 days for new versions, and don't change anything yet.
evals.expected_output: A table with action, current version, new version and age of the new version, headed by the 14-day minimum age; versions younger than 14 days are not offered but mentioned; no file in the repository is modified. For every action it offers a within-major alternative next to the newest major and warns that those within-major targets still declare node16 or node20.
assertions: No file in the repository is modified
The response states the 14-day minimum age
The response contains a table with at least four columns
The response mentions the codeql-action releases that are newer but younger than 14 days instead of offering them
For every action the report offers a version within the current major (same-major upgrade or pin) next to the newest major
The report warns that the within-major targets still declare a removed runtime (node16/node20)
The local action reference ./.github/actions/setup-py is unchanged
Nothing was committed

evals.name: targeted-selection-majors-allowed
evals.prompt: upgrade checkout and setup-node to the latest version, majors are fine
evals.expected_output: Only actions/checkout (both workflows) and actions/setup-node are rewritten, each to the newest version that is at least 7 days old, as @<sha> # vX.Y.Z; cache, codeql and setup-python are unchanged; a reminder to review the release notes of the major upgrades; no commit.
assertions: Every changed uses: line is pinned as @<40-hex sha> # vX.Y.Z
Each pinned SHA is the commit the commented version tag points at
Each new version's release is at least 7 days old
Both checkout occurrences and setup-node are upgraded
cache, codeql-action, and setup-python are left unchanged
The targets are major upgrades (latest allowed version, majors permitted)
The response points at release notes / breaking changes of the major upgrades
The local action reference ./.github/actions/setup-py is unchanged
Nothing was committed
The response reports release-note findings per upgraded action, not only a link
